## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and why this approach is appropriate.

## Validation

List the exact commands run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] `python test.py` passes.
- [ ] Python sources compile and `python -m pip check` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and relative links are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private images, restricted datasets, or per-image private
      predictions are included.
- [ ] Development results are not described as official or hidden-test scores.
- [ ] Checkpoint changes use Git LFS, update SHA-256 values, and include release
      verification evidence.
- [ ] New data or model dependencies include their provenance and usage terms.
